mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS unique_visitor_count , COALESCE(SUM(vu.user_scan_count), 0) AS total_scan_count , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN vu.user_scan_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revisit_count , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bf.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reviewed_visitor_count , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fav.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS favorited_visitor_count FROM ( SELECT user_id, SUM(visit_count) AS user_scan_count FROM booth_visits WHERE booth_id = #{boothId} GROUP BY user_id ) vu LEFT JOIN booth_feedbacks bf ON bf.booth_id = #{boothId} AND bf.user_id = vu.user_id LEFT JOIN booth_favorites fav ON fav.booth_id = #{boothId} AND fav.user_id = vu.user_id
SELECT DATE(first_visited_at) AS visit_date , COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS visitor_count FROM booth_visits WHERE booth_id = #{boothId} GROUP BY DATE(first_visited_at) ORDER BY visit_date ASC

SELECT COALESCE(rp.pet_species_snapshot, '미등록') AS label , COUNT(*) AS count FROM booth_visits bv LEFT JOIN reservation_pets rp ON rp.reservation_id = bv.reservation_id WHERE bv.booth_id = #{boothId} GROUP BY rp.pet_species_snapshot ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, rp.pet_birth_date_snapshot, bv.first_visited_at)) FROM booth_visits bv JOIN reservation_pets rp ON rp.reservation_id = bv.reservation_id WHERE bv.booth_id = #{boothId} AND rp.pet_birth_date_snapshot IS NOT NULL

SELECT pat.label AS label , COUNT(*) AS count FROM booth_visits bv JOIN reservation_pets rp ON rp.reservation_id = bv.reservation_id JOIN reservation_pet_allergies rpa ON rpa.reservation_pet_id = rp.reservation_pet_id JOIN pet_allergy_types pat ON pat.allergy_type_id = rpa.allergy_type_id WHERE bv.booth_id = #{boothId} GROUP BY pat.allergy_type_id, pat.label ORDER BY count DESC
